results.title: Cash Sale - AutoCount Resource Center
excerpts:
## Cash Sale

This is to create, edit or print cash sale.

Cash Sale if freshly added (did not transfer from other document), or transferred from Sales order or Quotation, will affect inventory movement (reduce stock level).

Cash Sale if transferred from Delivery Order will NOT affect inventory movement, because the stock level was reduced when that DO is saved.

Cash Sale will be posted to A/R Invoice Entry (look at the outstanding amount to indicate if it is fully paid), A/R Receive Payment and G/L Cash Book Entry (for the amount paid), and its related G/L accounts immediately upon Save.

**To Create New Cash Sale**

Go to _Sales > Cash Sale_

Click on _Create A New Cash Sale_

This is the default layout for cash sales (conventional), if you prefer Mini Pos Style layout, you can right click on blank area and choose Use Cash Sale Pos Layout.

```
                                                        POS Style Layout
```

...

**Shipping Info:** key in the info of shipping or transportation.

**Cash (F3):** click on this button if the customer is paying cash. This Cash Sale will be posted to: A/R Invoice Entry (fully knock-off, the outstanding amount will be zero), both A/R Receive Payment and G/L Cash Book Entry (for the amount paid), and its related G/L accounts (Sales account and Cash account) immediately upon Save.

**Credit Card (F7):** click on this button if the customer is paying by credit card.This Cash Sale will be posted to: A/R Invoice Entry (fully knock-off, the outstanding amount will be zero), both A/R Receive Payment and G/L Cash Book Entry (for the amount paid), and its related G/L accounts (Sales account and Bank account) immediately upon Save.

**Multi Payment (F8):** click on this button if the customer is paying by multi payment modes.
This Cash Sale will be posted to: A/R Invoice Entry (knock-off accordingly, could have outstanding amount), both A/R Receive Payment and G/L Cash Book Entry (for the amount paid), and its related G/L accounts (Sales account, Cash/Bank account and debtor account) immediately upon Save.

**Credit Sales (F5):** click on this button if the customer is not paying at the moment. (will pay at other time/day)

**Functional Buttons** :

 to be save in K.I.V folder to be use later.

 to be save as template. (Refer Template)

 to be save as recurrence. (Refer recurrence)

 to add / insert a detail row. (Insert)

 to insert a detail row before the highlighted row. (Ctrl + Insert)

 to delete highlighted row. (Ctrl + Delete)

  to move the detail row up/down. (Alt + Shift + Up/Down)

 to undo (Ctrl + Z)

 to select all detail rows (Ctrl + Alt + A), so that it can be deleted or modified in one shot (using Range Set)

 range set (F12)... a range setting windows will be prompted.
This is usually used to apply changes to several/all selected detail rows.

 to set the GST date of the document.

 to add a subtotal row, showing the subtotal amount.

 to add a discount row, and for you to define the group discount by define the percentage % or Value.

 to find item package item.

 to show the total cost of the item.

 to change the unit price for the item.

 to prompt the item search screen (F9). Type a keyword, select search criteria, click on _Search_ . From the search result, check the check-boxes to select items to be included into the document, then click on _OK_ .

 click on this button will display (at bottom section) instant information related to the highlighted item, such as Price History, Stock Balance ...

 to copy a cash sale which previously already save.

 to copy existing cash sale to a new cash sale.

 to transfer quotation to cash sale.

 to transfer sales order to cash sale.

 to transfer delivery order to cash sale.

...
